decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Full details of the following to include section at scale 1:5 as appropriate
A)  French doors to rear and side
B)  Dormer window
C)  First Floor Conservatory

Be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 4 - A sample roof tile showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on side and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works.
Condition : 5 - All external joinery shall be of painted timber.
description: Rebuilding and centralising of existing rear ground floor french doors, rebuilding of first floor rear conservatory, rebuilding and alteration to existing rear roof extension, raising of parapet wall, resiting of stained glass window on ground floor side wall and renewal of roof coverings to existing dwellinghouse and construction of French doors on ground floor side wall.   LISTED BUILDING APPLICATION
